goal: Prevent quadratic runtime when libbitcoinkernel consumers read entire witness stacks
Make single witness item access constant time instead of scanning from the start
agreement: Approach approval while suggesting offsets over spans to cut memory use (stickies-v)
Earlier objections about pointer lifetimes and traversal order were addressed (ajtowns)

categories.name: kernel
why: P3 because it fixes quadratic runtime when callers read an entire witness stack
Benefit is limited to external callers of the libbitcoinkernel witness stack API
